import * as React from "react";
import { act, fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import type { ChatTransport, UIMessage, UIMessageChunk } from "ai";
import { ConnectedChat } from "./src/components/connected-chat";

function mockTransport() {
  let controller: ReadableStreamDefaultController<UIMessageChunk>;
  let abortSignal: AbortSignal | undefined;
  let count = 0;
  const sendMessages = vi.fn<ChatTransport<UIMessage>["sendMessages"]>(async (options) => {
    abortSignal = options.abortSignal;
    return new ReadableStream<UIMessageChunk>({ start(value) {
      controller = value;
      controller.enqueue({ type: "start", messageId: `answer-${++count}` });
      controller.enqueue({ type: "text-start", id: "text" });
      abortSignal?.addEventListener("abort", () => controller.error(new DOMException("Aborted", "AbortError")), { once: true });
    } });
  });
  return {
    transport: { sendMessages, reconnectToStream: async () => null } satisfies ChatTransport<UIMessage>,
    sendMessages,
    push(text: string) { controller.enqueue({ type: "text-delta", id: "text", delta: text }); },
    unsupported() { controller.enqueue({ type: "reasoning-start", id: "reason" }); controller.enqueue({ type: "reasoning-delta", id: "reason", delta: "Hidden?" }); controller.enqueue({ type: "reasoning-end", id: "reason" }); },
    fail() { controller.error(new Error("Private provider error")); },
    finish() { controller.enqueue({ type: "text-end", id: "text" }); controller.enqueue({ type: "finish" }); controller.close(); },
    get aborted() { return abortSignal?.aborted; },
  };
}
async function send(text = "Make a plan") {
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole("textbox"), { target: { value: text } });
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Send message" }));
  await act(async () => {});
}

it("streams the copied Block using the real SDK and a mock transport", async () => {
  const mock = mockTransport();
  render(<ConnectedChat transport={mock.transport} />);
  await send();
  expect(mock.sendMessages).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  expect(mock.sendMessages.mock.calls[0][0].messages[0].parts).toEqual([{ type: "text", text: "Make a plan" }]);
  await act(async () => mock.push("First result"));
  expect(screen.getByText("First result")).toBeVisible();
  expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Stop response" })).toBeEnabled();
  await act(async () => mock.finish());
  expect(screen.getByText("Ready for your next message.")).toBeVisible();
});
it("preserves partial output and newer edits through failure and retry without duplicating the user", async () => {
  const mock = mockTransport(); render(<ConnectedChat transport={mock.transport} />);
  await send();
  await act(async () => mock.push("Partial response"));
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole("textbox"), { target: { value: "Newer question" } });
  await act(async () => mock.fail());
  expect(screen.queryByText("Private provider error")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(screen.getByText("Partial response")).toBeVisible();
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Retry response" }));
  await waitFor(() => expect(mock.sendMessages).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2));
  expect(screen.getByText("Partial response")).toBeVisible();
  expect(mock.sendMessages.mock.calls[1][0].trigger).toBe("regenerate-message");
  await act(async () => { mock.push("Replacement"); mock.finish(); });
  expect(screen.queryByText("Partial response")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(screen.getAllByText("Make a plan")).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(screen.getByRole("textbox")).toHaveValue("Newer question");
});
it("awaits cancellation, ignores late chunks and allows a fresh request", async () => {
  const mock = mockTransport(); render(<ConnectedChat transport={mock.transport} />);
  await send(); await act(async () => mock.push("Kept output"));
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Stop response" }));
  await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/may be incomplete/)).toBeVisible());
  expect(mock.aborted).toBe(true);
  expect(() => mock.push("Late chunk")).toThrow();
  expect(screen.queryByText(/Late chunk/)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(screen.getByText("Kept output")).toBeVisible();
  await send("A fresh request");
  await act(async () => { mock.push("Fresh result"); mock.finish(); });
  expect(screen.getByText("Ready for your next message.")).toBeVisible();
});
it("marks unsupported rich content instead of silently declaring success", async () => {
  const mock = mockTransport(); render(<ConnectedChat transport={mock.transport} />);
  await send();
  await act(async () => { mock.unsupported(); mock.push("Text"); mock.finish(); });
  expect(screen.getByText(/Configure a text-only response/)).toBeVisible();
  expect(screen.getByText(/Unsupported response content/)).toBeVisible();
});
it("aborts transport when its consumer unmounts", async () => {
  const mock = mockTransport(); const { unmount } = render(<ConnectedChat transport={mock.transport} />);
  await send(); unmount();
  await act(async () => {});
  expect(mock.aborted).toBe(true);
});

import { AgentChat } from "./src/components/agent-chat";
import type { AgentDefinitionDraft } from "./src/components/blocks/ai-chat";

it("creates only the explicitly reviewed agent revision and exports the edited definition", async () => {
  const confirm = vi.fn(async (snapshot: AgentDefinitionDraft) => snapshot);
  render(<AgentChat confirm={confirm} />);
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Define an agent (sample)" }));
  expect(confirm).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  expect(screen.queryByRole("heading", { name: "Agent definition" })).toBeNull();
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Send message" }));
  expect(confirm).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: /Agent name/ }), { target: { value: "My consumer reviewer" } });
  await act(async () => fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm definition" })));
  expect(confirm).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  expect(confirm.mock.calls[0][0].revision).toBe(1);
  expect(screen.getByText("Definition created locally")).toBeVisible();
  expect(JSON.parse(screen.getByLabelText("Confirmed definition JSON").textContent!)).toMatchObject({ schemaVersion: 1, name: "My consumer reviewer" });
});
it("ignores a delayed consumer result after cancellation and replacement", async () => {
  let done!: (snapshot: AgentDefinitionDraft) => void;
  let submitted!: AgentDefinitionDraft;
  const confirm = vi.fn((snapshot: AgentDefinitionDraft) => { submitted = snapshot; return new Promise<AgentDefinitionDraft>((resolve) => { done = resolve; }); });
  render(<AgentChat confirm={confirm} />);
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Define an agent (sample)" }));
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Send message" }));
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm definition" }));
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel definition" }));
  expect(screen.getByText(/Definition cancelled/)).toBeVisible();
  await act(async () => {});
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Message" }), { target: { value: "Define a product review assistant." } });
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Send message" }));
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: /Agent name/ }), { target: { value: "New draft" } });
  await act(async () => done(submitted));
  expect(screen.queryByText("Definition created locally")).toBeNull();
  expect(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: /Agent name/ })).toHaveValue("New draft");
  expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm definition" })).toBeEnabled();
});
it("preserves failed confirmation edits and retries the same revision", async () => {
  const confirm = vi.fn<(snapshot: AgentDefinitionDraft) => Promise<AgentDefinitionDraft>>()
    .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error("Private backend detail"))
    .mockImplementation(async (snapshot) => snapshot);
  render(<AgentChat confirm={confirm} />);
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Define an agent (sample)" }));
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Send message" }));
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: /Instructions/ }), { target: { value: "Keep my changes" } });
  await act(async () => fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm definition" })));
  expect(screen.queryByText("Private backend detail")).toBeNull();
  expect(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: /Instructions/ })).toHaveValue("Keep my changes");
  await act(async () => fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Retry confirmation" })));
  expect(confirm).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  expect(confirm.mock.calls[1][0]).toEqual(confirm.mock.calls[0][0]);
  expect(screen.getByText("Definition created locally")).toBeVisible();
});
